title: How far can bias go? Tracing bias from pretraining data to alignment

bias_targets.methodology: Measuring the co-occurrence of gender-identifying tokens (e.g., pronouns) and occupational terms in both the pre-training dataset (Dolma) and LLM-generated outputs elicited via zero-shot prompting. The paper quantifies this using the Stereotypical Association (STA) metric and evaluates bias amplification between the training data and model outputs.
